about_pullquote: We treat every home like it's our own — fast, honest, and no hidden charges.
about_para_1: Prestige Plumbing has served Derby and the surrounding area for over 15 years. We started because we were tired of seeing local homeowners and landlords charged eye-watering prices for simple fixes by cowboys. From burst pipes at midnight to annual boiler servicing, we've built our reputation on turning up when we say we will, diagnosing problems quickly, and charging fair rates with no surprises.
about_para_2: Our customers keep coming back because we answer the phone, we listen, and we fix things properly. We carry parts on the van, we work late, and we don't leave until the job is done. Whether you're a homeowner dealing with an emergency or a landlord managing a portfolio, you'll find us reliable, straightforward, and genuinely interested in solving your plumbing problem.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on a Sunday morning and thought I'd be in for a long wait. Called Prestige and they were here in 50 minutes. Fixed it properly, no mess, and the cost was way less than I expected. Brilliant service. Will be using them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our boiler broke down just before Christmas. The lads came out same day, replaced the part, and got us heating again by evening. They were polite, explained everything, and didn't try to sell us an unnecessary new boiler like the last lot. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer L.

reviews.text: Used Prestige for a full bathroom refit. From start to finish, they were professional and tidy. Finished on time, pipes don't leak, and they cleaned up properly after themselves. Good price, no nonsense. Will be calling them back for our kitchen next year.
reviews.author: David K.
